title: The crossing
text:
Ships work the coast when they can and strike across when they must. A coastal passage is slower, cheaper, and has somewhere to run to. Open water is the reverse.

Passage is bought, worked, or owed. A master who takes you without payment is either doing you a favor or putting you in his ledger, and he will tell you which.

provenance.notes: Coastal and open-water options are a game abstraction of real sailing choices.
